charity = an organisation that helps people in need; giving help
volunteer = someone who works for no pay to help others
donate = to give money or things to help a person or charity
homeless = without a place to live
poverty = the state of being extremely poor
crime = an action that is against the law
steal = to take something that is not yours
burglar = a person who breaks into a building to steal
fine = money you must pay as a punishment
law = the system of rules in a country
obey = to do what a rule or person tells you
rights = things you are allowed to have or do by law
election = an event when people vote for a leader or party
vote = to choose in an election; one choice
government = the group of people who run a country
citizen = a person who belongs to a country and has rights there
community = the people who live in the same area
protest = a public event where people show they disagree
campaign = planned actions to change people's opinions or raise money
bullying = hurting someone again and again, with words or actions
